system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"hey so a while back i tweeted about Spotify premium not transferring over local files to my iPhone SO I changed the WiFi I was using on both devices, uninstalled on both, logged out on both etc. But still not working??"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Just to make sure we're on the same page, are you trying to sync the local files from your desktop to your iPhone? Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks troubleshooting steps and empathy; needs clearer guidance and support."}
